headword: {士族階級|しぞくかいきゅう}
gloss: the samurai class; the shizoku class

definitions.gloss: the samurai class; the former-warrior (shizoku) class
definitions.explanation: The social class made up of former samurai families, an official category designated in the Meiji era after feudal warrior status was abolished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{士族階級|しぞくかいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だ。
examples.english: He comes from the samurai class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{士族階級|しぞくかいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特権|とっけん}→特権：13499_tokken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, the privileges of the samurai class were lost.

examples.japanese: {士族階級|しぞくかいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: Many of the former samurai class lost their positions and struggled to make a living.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{士族|しぞく}→士族：12659_shizoku⟧ ('former-samurai family class') + ⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧ ('class, rank'). ⟦{士族|しぞく}→士族：12659_shizoku⟧ was an official social category created in the Meiji period for ex-samurai households.

ETYMOLOGY:
After the feudal system was dismantled, samurai lost their stipends and privileges. The phrase ⟦{士族|しぞく}→士族：12659_shizoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商法|しょうほう}→商法：30086_shouhou⟧ ('samurai's way of doing business') mocks their often-unsuccessful ventures into commerce.

RELATED WORDS:
- {華族|かぞく}: the peerage/nobility class of the same era
- {平民|へいみん}: commoners
